test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If 26 September 2005 was Monday, then what was the day of the week on 26 September 2017?
solution: Given: **26 September 2005** was Monday. Now, 2005 to 2017 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years). And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.
